items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know that Custer was such a dolt, trying to go out there and fight them Indians

ctx.x: All that was still wide-open country.

I remember a time when I got to South Dakota, the Black Hills of South Dakota. And we got to a place where they had this statue of Custer's Last Stand. Boy, I thought I was seeing the most important thing that ever happened in history. I didn't know that Custer was such a dolt, trying to go out there and fight them Indians, the way they fight.
